about: Mix-and-match sections for gyms, fitness studios, boxing/MMA clubs, bootcamps and personal/online trainers, from 12 Dribbble full-page references (1–12.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg. These designs live on high-contrast athletic photography (moody gym interiors, sweat, cut-out athletes): use the lead's real trainers, members and facility photos first, then fitness stock. Membership prices, member counts, ratings and transformation numbers must come from FACTS — otherwise drop the figures or use 'From $—' placeholders only if pricing is clearly offered.
